top_signals.title: Shanghai Exchange Halts Duty-Free Metal Delivery Against Futures
top_signals.summary: The Shanghai Futures Exchange has suspended the settlement of copper and aluminum futures with deliveries from duty-free warehouses, a mechanism that has long helped Chinese traders avoid paying taxes on metal that can be sold overseas.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: What’s a Revolution in Military Affairs Good For?
top_signals.summary:
For decades, militaries have chased the next revolution in warfare. But what actually makes a revolution in military affairs revolutionary? Is there one happening now? Does it matter? Is it just about drones and AI or something more? Ryan digs into the promises, pitfalls, and persistent myths of military transformation with Mike Horowitz (Penn), Stacie Pettyjohn (CNAS), and Benjamin Jensen (CSIS).
